kind: representative public-site compatibility fixtures (minimal synthetic forms)
fetched_at_note: URLs, HTTP status and fetch timestamp are as reported by parent research; this worker did not re-fetch or contact the sites.

extra_text_input.role: extra text input; production purpose and visibility were not inferred

normalization.required_field_suffix: random production suffix replaced by the fixed literal required_field_fixture; the original suffix was not retained
normalization.attributes: only the reported input attributes are reproduced, and the reported element identifiers are used as id values
not_reproduced: page markup, styles, scripts and assets
any field value, CSRF token or cookie

synthetic: Both fixtures are minimal synthetic forms, not clones of the production pages.
data-synthetic=container marks form/button containers absent from the research capture.
data-synthetic=negative-case-decoy marks the hidden required_field_fixture input as a synthetic negative case, not a production field.
Fixtures contain no external scripts, styles, images, fonts or requests.

scope.tested: DOM component compatibility of the shipped browser-extension core probe/capture/fill against representative forms
not_tested: no account, cookie, credential or WebAuthn ceremony was used
no production login or submission was performed
not a browser->native, extension-privileged or end-to-end login test
the driver never contacts the live sites
